title: Upfront sync preview — Talia notes
body:
Purpose:
Quick, asymmetric pre-read for Monday sync — highlight what needs decisions vs FYIs. Personal scratchpad, will copy into meeting doc after final edits. Keep timeboxed.

Context / background (1-2 lines each):
- KV cache regression: heatmap shows miss rate up 12% after small patch; impacts 99th pctl latency on long-context jobs. (INF-1423 linked).
- Console latency spike: several dashboard queries timed out last night 03:00–04:30 UTC; likely tracing sampling change + burst traffic.
- Autoscale policy MDF experiment: small group still seeing cold-starts between 250->400 rps, need feedback from Dedicated pool owners on burst policy.
- Private rollout checklist: customer A wants HSM integration test sign-off by EOW.

Proposed agenda (30 min total):
1) 5m: Quick state check (who's oncall / high-priority blocking) — owner: me (Talia).
2) 10m: KV cache regression triage & short-term mitigations — owner: Ethan.
   - What we know: patch X changed cache eviction window; reproducer in staging (staging-run-2026-03-09).
   - Ask decisions: revert vs targeted patch; rollback criteria; define monitoring for rollforward.
3) 7m: Console spike follow-up & tracing sampling revert plan — owner: Marta.
   - Data: dashboard query timeouts (03:00–04:30); correlate with agent rollout.
   - Quick ask: agree to temporarily drop sampling to 0.5% for dashboards during peak hours.
4) 5m: Autoscale / Dedicated burst behavior check — owner: Omar.
   - Note: recommend short grace period + pre-warm heuristic for recent patterns.
5) 3m: Quick readout on Private/HSM status & next steps — owner: me.

Prep notes (for leads):
- Ethan: bring a short runbook fragment for rollback (one-liner command + monitoring checks).
- Marta: bring metric slices and at least one correlation chart (traces vs. dashboard queries).
- Omar: bring logs showing cold-start counts per pool over last 48h.

Decision points we need in meeting:
- Rollback of cache patch (yes/no) AND who owns rollback + rollback window.
- Temp tracing sampling change (yes/no) + owner to push change.
- Autoscale tweak: approve 60s pre-warm or run more telemetry for another sprint.

Action-item tracker (my informal view / will convert to a Google Sheet later):
- [ ] INF-1423: Create rollback PR for cache patch (Ethan) — due: 2026-03-12 — status: in progress (Ethan started branch).
- [ ] Dashboard sampling change (Marta) — due: 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC — status: pending approval.
- [ ] Autoscale pre-warm experiment: add 60s pre-warm to canary pool (Omar) — due: 2026-03-15 — status: proposed.
- [ ] Private deployment HSM test plan: write test matrix & owner assignment (Talia + Solutions Eng) — due: 2026-03-13 — status: drafting.
- [ ] Monitoring alert: add 99th-latency alert for long-context jobs (SLO owner) — due: 2026-03-14 — status: needs owner.

Parking lot / things to handle asynchronously:
- Longer-term: look at cache eviction policy math and consider adaptive TTLs based on seq len distribution. (Research ticket?)
- Observability: sample lower-cost aggregate traces for dashboard queries rather than full traces.
- Postmortem if rollback happens: quick timeline & impact estimate; keep draft in Confluence.

Questions / open items to call out in meeting:
- If we rollback cache patch, will any customers see material behavior change (specific customers pinned to patch)? Need SME input.
- Is there appetite to accept a short-term increase in token-cost (more cache warmups) to preserve latency SLOs?

Notes to self (bits to copy to meeting doc):
- Start meeting on time; capture decisions as single-line action items in chat so I can paste.
- Keep discussion on KV cache to 10m and move extended debugging to separate deep-dive.

Quick timeline for Monday:
- 08:50: finalize agenda in meeting doc; paste in Slack #serving-runtime.
- 09:00: run meeting.
- 09:35: update tracker & assign owners.

End of scratchpad.

(Hands-on checklist / daily reminders)
- Check staging reproducer runs before meeting (local job id: repro-2026-03-09-03).
- Ping SRE on sampling change dependency (Marta to ping).

---
Metadata notes for later: will copy to shared drive meeting doc and mark final after owners ack.
